recommendation: Keep the audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-26654 unless PA later changes the PractitionerRole/service-language policy captured in FHIR-54008.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification PA issue requesting Practitioner.communication to become a Patient/RelatedPerson/Person-like BackboneElement with language and preferred children, adding PractitionerRole.communication for patient-facing role languages, and clarifying PractitionerRole and HealthcareService communication text.
